parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name.<props="china">You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29751.html) operation to obtain the domain name.</props><props="intl">You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains) operation to obtain the domain name.</props>

parameters.name: KeyWord
parameters.description: The keyword. The system searches for the keyword in the "%KeyWord%" pattern. The search is not case-sensitive.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**.
